q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Sales did not drop — net sales rose to ₹91,220 on 2026-10-13 (up 127.4% vs 2026-10-12 when net sales were ₹40,119). The data shows a clear increase, so there is no drop to explain.

- What moved most: Orders rose from 26 → 45 (+73.1%), which added most of the lift; Net AOV rose from ₹1,543 → ₹2,027 (+31.3%), amplifying the revenue gain.  
- Offsetting items worth noting: Refund/return-related bookings were higher (refunds ₹11,340 → ₹32,464, +186.2%) but remained within their normal range and do not negate the higher sales.  
- Marketing and traffic: Ad spend increased ₹38,661 → ₹50,440 (+30.5%) and Sessions were similar-to-higher (3,254 → 3,434); these moved with sales but the analysis found no single upstream cause (correlation, not proven causation).
